title: Bulgarian — BGN/PCGN 1952
authority: US Board on Geographic Names (1949) and UK Permanent Committee on Geographical Names (1952); replaced in 2013 by the BGN/PCGN adoption of the Bulgarian 2009 system
description: English-oriented geographic-names system used on US/UK maps and gazetteers until 2013 and found in older English-language sources: Х→kh, Ъ→ŭ, Ь→’, and no -ia exception (София → Sofiya, България → Bŭlgariya).
notes: The UN WGRS report prints the soft sign as ’ (U+2019); other copies use an ASCII apostrophe or ʹ. In modern spelling ь occurs only before о (Кольо → Kol’o).
Note 1 of the system: word-final ъ (pre-1945 spelling) is omitted (Иванъ → Ivan); implemented as a rule.
Note 4: тс 'may be romanized t·s' to distinguish it from ц; optional, not applied here.
Obsolete ѫ → ŭ; obsolete ѣ → e or ya according to local pronunciation when known, otherwise ye (ye is used here).
Accented ѝ/ѐ are not in the table; mapped to i/e.

rules.note: Note 1: word-final ъ of pre-1945 spelling is omitted
